description: This file defines the main page component for a real-time OEE monitoring frontend. It renders informational UI elements including a dashboard header, status cards for availability, performance, and quality metrics, and a getting started checklist with navigation links. It primarily contains React functional components and JSX markup.

methods.name: StatCard
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a styled statistic card with title, value, and hint.

methods.name: Home
methods.description: The main React component for the homepage, rendering the dashboard and the getting started checklist.
